title: SEC3: mixed test vector encoding styles in test file
description: crypto2dev_test.c uses two styles to express test vectors. Tests 1-3b use hex string literals decoded at runtime via hex_decode(). Tests 5-6 use static const byte[] initializers with hex byte literals. test_tls13_integration mixes both in the same function (hex_decode for expected SHA/HMAC, byte-literal initializer for AES key/IV). Pick one style and apply it consistently. Runtime hex_decode adds code that cannot be inspected by a diff viewer; static const byte[] is more grep-friendly and has zero runtime cost.
